description: Per-purpose duplicate governance: physical counts for descriptive statistics, effective membership for reference distributions, isolation for evaluation, and an explicit non-decision for future model development. Ratifies the Stage-5 deterministic representative selection with conditions.
scope: corpus duplicate groups (348 scope-level; 240 documents; 120 folded groups)

statements.statement: Physical N counts all source documents; source records are never deleted.
Descriptive corpus statistics keep all documents and report duplicates as a documented quality fact.
Reference distributions use effective membership (canonical members only, canonical = lexicographically smallest document_id).
Every distribution record carries the duplicate policy id; missingness and duplicate sensitivity are reported, never imputed.
Duplicate-group members are never split across development/evaluation boundaries.
Changing the representative-selection rule requires a major policy amendment and methodological review.
Duplicate handling for future model development is not settled by this policy and requires a separate Researcher decision.
